blocks.x: How Tele Medicine Platform is built: encrypted video, HIS integration and consent-first session handling.

Consultations run over encrypted video infrastructure; clinical data integrates with the hospital's systems through standard interfaces. Access follows the same discipline as in-person care: the care team and the patient, nothing wider.
